plan.name: Extract the statue task hook
plan.summary: Move starting, polling, reload recovery, the one-task guard, progress, naming and dismissal into hooks/use-statue-task.ts, awaiting an AppShell delivery callback before releasing the guard. Keep photo selection and ordering, conversion at 80 mm, mesh uploads and source-photo metadata, suggestions, viewer replacement, repair warnings and library saving in components/app-shell.tsx, wiring Generate and Clear to the hook and preserving its StatueProgress type export for existing consumers. Preserve all messages, the four-second wait before each poll, stopping on the fifth consecutive poll failure with a reset after any successful poll, and recovery of queued/running tasks or successful tasks younger than 600 seconds; keep both known recovery bugs, including the recovered-statue.stl name and re-delivery after reload without an explicit dismissal. Route the hook's sidecar calls through lib/statue.ts and centralize best-effort dismissal storage there under the existing ask3d:dismissed-statue-task key, without introducing cancellation of an in-flight task when Clear is pressed. Update README.md's component map to describe the hook and the component's delivery responsibilities.

tests.name: Statue start and delivery
tests.says: useStatueTask({onDeliver,onError}) returns progress, start({images,engine,sourceName,sourcePath}) and dismiss(); it sends the supplied photos in order, waits four seconds before each poll, reports the original progress, and delivers the downloaded bytes, chosen filename, format, source path, provenance and repair warning once while guarding the entire operation.
tests.selector: statue task hook starts one task and awaits delivery with the original progress and metadata

tests.name: Consecutive poll failure tolerance
tests.says: Four poll failures are retried at four-second intervals, any successful response resets the count, and the fifth consecutive failure reports the original error and releases the guard for another task.
tests.selector: statue task hook resets poll failures after a response and stops at the fifth consecutive failure

tests.name: Original start failure messages
tests.says: The hook keeps the existing service, engine-install, busy, quota, already-generating and ordinary error messages, clears errors only on an accepted start, and releases progress and the guard after failure.
tests.selector: statue task hook preserves health checks engine readiness and generation error messages

tests.name: Terminal outcomes and delivery errors
tests.says: Failed tasks never download or deliver; successful tasks keep STL/OBJ formats or default a missing format to GLB, preserve optional provenance, and download or callback failures use the existing error path.
tests.selector: statue task hook preserves failed tasks format defaults and download or delivery errors

tests.name: Reload recovery and known bugs
tests.says: Mount recovery accepts queued/running tasks regardless of age and succeeded tasks strictly younger than ten minutes, using recovered-statue.stl and no source photo; it still re-delivers an undismissed task on a later mount and names a different recovered task the same way.
tests.selector: statue task hook recovers only eligible latest tasks and retains the known recovery behavior

tests.name: Dismissal and storage failures
tests.says: Dismiss writes the last adopted task ID to the existing key, suppresses that ID on reload, does not stop a task already in flight, and retains the old best-effort behavior when localStorage reads or writes fail.
tests.selector: statue task hook persists dismissal without cancelling delivery and tolerates unavailable storage

tests.name: Recovery races and errors
tests.says: A late latest-task response cannot adopt over an active start or after effect cleanup; recovery holds the same guard through delivery and reports raw errors, preserving its difference from the fresh-generation quota translation.
tests.selector: statue task hook ignores late recovery after start or unmount and keeps recovery errors verbatim
